name: naranyala-pi-ext-companion-for-c-programming
description: The C-Programming Companion is a specialized extension for the pi coding agent designed to accelerate the development, debugging, and refactoring of C and C++ codebases. It provides a suite of professional-grade tools that integrate directly into the agent's workflow, enabling deep inspection of system headers, binary analysis, and more.
